_schema: The cell library behind the pack designer. One record per cell: cell_id, name, chemistry (must be one BatteryModel knows), form (cylindrical or pouch), specs and a source plus a basis. `basis` is "datasheet" when the figures are the manufacturer's published ones for that exact cell, and "class-typical" when no single datasheet stands behind them (generic LiPo pouch classes): those are representative of the size class, chosen to sit in the same range as the shipped pack presets, and are NOT a specific product. Every figure here is an ideal / datasheet figure, never a measurement of a cell on a bench. specs: mah is rated capacity; nominal_v the datasheet nominal per cell; max_cont_a and max_burst_a the published continuous and short-pulse discharge limits (pouch classes: C rating x Ah, burst 1.5x to 2x); r_mohm is the per-cell internal resistance (datasheet AC impedance for cylindrical cells, a class-typical DC figure for pouch); mass_g is the bare cell. `burst_basis` of "estimate" marks a max_burst_a the datasheet does not publish (unverified; not a measurement). Dimensions: cylindrical cells carry diameter_mm and length_mm; pouch cells carry length_mm, width_mm and thickness_mm.
